subject: SparrowAI marketplace private-offer: approval playline & MAP
messages:
From: Danielle Li <danielle.li@sparrowai.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@sparrowai.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T15:12:00Z
Subject: Marketplace private offer + MAP request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — SparrowAI is excited about Redwood's latency profile for the embedding pipeline. Procurement has asked for a clear mutual action plan and confirmation of the AWS private-offer path before we put together the PO.

High level asks from our side:
- A mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones, owners and dates so our procurement and legal teams can track progress.
- Confirmation of the "Marketplace private offer" flow: who issues the invoice, how billing is routed, and whether Redwood will accept purchase orders placed through AWS private offers.
- SOC2 evidence and a short list of required contract exceptions (if any) so our legal team can start redlines.

Can you share a MAP template and an estimated close timeline? We are targeting a sign-off from finance in ~3 weeks if items are lined up.

Cheers,
Danielle Li
Head of Integrations
SparrowAI

Attachments: none in this initial note (will share procurement contacts).

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Li <danielle.li@sparrowai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-10T19:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer + MAP request

Danielle — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is an initial MAP (SparrowAI_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short playline that covers procurement -> PO -> billing. Initial summary below; full details in the attachment.

Summary MAP (high level):
- Week 0 (Sep 10): Align on procurement contact + MAP owners (completed).
- Week 1 (Sep 13): Legal share of contract redlines and SOC2 pointer (SparrowAI).
- Week 2 (Sep 20): Finalize PO/Private-offer terms; Redwood to prepare PO template and DocuSign flow.
- Week 3 (Sep 27): Execute private offer in AWS, billing kick-off, invoice generation and first-month credit to reflect marketplace fee structure.

Marketplace billing notes (short):
- For AWS private offers: Redwood issues invoice (net 30 by default) and AWS acts as the transactional vehicle. We will accept PO referencing the private-offer ID; finance will reconcile on our side.
- Option: If Sparrow wishes to have AWS bill directly and pass-through to Redwood, we can map that in the MAP but it requires a small delay while Marketplace procurement confirms flow.

I've cc'd Ben (marketplace ops) and Marcus (legal) to support the specifics.

Next steps:
1) Can Rajiv (procurement) send the procurement email/contact and any internal deadlines?
2) Marcus — can you confirm the minimal contract exceptions that typically hold up private-offer closures?
3) Ben/Jordan — can you confirm expected timeline for creating the private-offer in AWS once PO is in-hand?

I'll set a 30-minute cadence for the next two weeks if that helps keep momentum.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: SparrowAI_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Li <danielle.li@sparrowai.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer + MAP request

Looping in Lauren from billing to confirm invoice flow and Jordan for marketplace config. Quick notes from ops: 

- Private offer creation time: once legal/PO is signed and we receive the signed PO, we generally onboard the private offer in 2-4 business days (less if all metadata is provided).
- Billing routing: standard is Redwood invoices SparrowAI net 30 with the AWS private-offer reference on the invoice. If Sparrow wants AWS to be the bill-to, we need to coordinate a marketplace billing pass-through which typically adds an extra 7-10 days for procurement approval.
- Credits: If we agreed to an initial onboarding credit, we can apply it on first invoice. Please specify credit amount in the PO or confirm in email.

Lauren — can you confirm Redwood's finance contact and provide the invoice template we expect to use here?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference

> On Thu, Sep 10, 2026 at 19:03 Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Danielle — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is an initial MAP (SparrowAI_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short playline that covers procurement -> PO -> billing. Initial summary below; full details in the attachment.

From: Danielle Li <danielle.li@sparrowai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@sparrowai.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace private offer + MAP request

Thanks Ben — that matches our expectations. Per procurement (Rajiv is cc'd):
- We prefer Redwood to invoice SparrowAI directly (net 30).
- We will issue a PO referencing the AWS private-offer ID; please provide the PO template so we can populate internal fields.
- SOC2: uploading to our vendor portal this afternoon.

Rajiv (procurement) will own the PO submission; Rajiv, can you share any internal cutoffs or FI requirements? Our legal will try to limit exceptions to data residency and liability caps — we'll surface specifics by Monday (Sep 14).

On the credit: SparrowAI would like a one-time onboarding credit equal to 25% of first month estimated usage. If Redwood can confirm that in the MAP, procurement will prioritize the PO.

Regards,
Danielle Li

Attachments: none (SOC2 link to follow via vendor portal)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Li <danielle.li@sparrowai.com>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@sparrowai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:03:00Z
Subject: RE: Marketplace private offer + MAP request

Danielle / Rajiv — thanks, this is helpful. I've attached a finalized MAP and a PO template (PO_template_SparrowAI.pdf). Key updates:

- Onboarding credit: Redwood confirms a one-time onboarding credit equal to 25% of SparrowAI's estimated first-month usage. Please annotate PO to reflect credit so finance can apply during invoice generation.
- Legal redlines: Marcus will accept standard data residency language; any deviation flagged as "material" will require exec review (we've carved a 48-hour SLA for exec escalation in the MAP).
- Private-offer activation window: Jordan confirms 2 business days after we receive signed PO + marketplace metadata.
- Invoice path: Redwood issues invoice net 30 with private-offer ID on the invoice. We will reconcile with AWS billing records.

Action items (owners/dates):
- Rajiv (SparrowAI): Submit PO referencing private-offer ID and include credit line — target Sep 17.
- Marcus (Redwood): Draft minimal redline summary and circulate by Sep 16.
- Jordan (Redwood): Prepare marketplace metadata template for Sparrow to fill (Sep 16).
- Kimberly/Ben: Schedule a 30-minute sign-off call for Sep 18 to confirm PO and timeline.

Please confirm the Sep 17 PO target and I'll lock the Sep 18 call on calendars.

Best regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: PO_template_SparrowAI.pdf; SOC2_evidence_link.txt
